#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="50100">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />50100 ANLC - Relative density exceeds variance validation limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="50100">

This exception is for Gas meters only. It is driven off of Calculation Variance Validations in the Meter Editor.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 611;height: 507;" />

Users can import/edit a relative density. When this is filled out and imported, FLOWCAL will calculate a relative density based off of the Mole %’s given. If the difference between the FLOWCAL calculated relative density and imported/edited relative density exceeds the Calculation Variance Validation point then Exception 50100 will be generated.

Comparisons for unit differences are done by rounding both the calculated and the measured values to 4 decimal places. Comparison calculations for percent difference use unrounded calculated and measured values, but the percent difference calculated are rounded to 4 decimal places before comparing to the specified limit.

</div>
